title: Restyle Video: LTX-2.3
description: A video given a new look: the motion and camera of your video are kept, the look comes from a style frame and the prompt (LTX-2.3 IC-LoRA, with sound).

labels.900:value: Describe the new look (the motion comes from the video)
labels.901:value: Seconds of the video to use
labels.199:file: Source video (its motion and camera are kept)
labels.200:image: Style frame (its first frame with the new look)

pick_when: Restyle a longer clip at 720p quickly, keeping its sound. In tests a painted style washed out and the clothes changed by the end: Wan VACE or Fun Control hold a style better.
hints: Make the style frame from the video's first frame with a picture model, so the people and their places match.
Describe what changes: the place, the clothes, the light, the style.
